snippet.title: Carnival Hunt Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Survive an ever-changing mechanical carnival in this asymmetrical horror multiplayer experience. One player becomes the Carnival Monster while the others struggle to escape as puppet-like bunnies.

Developed by Crytivo and Beer Night Studio, published by Crytivo.

#TheIndiePremier #GameShowcase #IndieGames #CarnivalHunt
